method: Three phases, all with HumanBot + MID_GAME_STATE loadout (run_farm.py). Phase 1: bisection on the continuous --density knob (tools/musiccal/tune_density.py), n=60 probes -- noisy but revealed the plateau. Phase 2: a fine sweep (n=120 each) across density in [0.225,0.240], which turned out to all round() to the SAME 10-enemy level (43*density in [9.675,10.32] all round to 10) -- i.e. phase 2 is really 4 independent n=120 samples of ONE level, pooled below for a tighter estimate. Phase 3: locked density=10/43 exactly and ran a fresh n=250 confirmation batch (disjoint seed block) for the reported number.

phases.description: bisection on --density, n=60 probes per point (uses the FIXED proportional-fair enemy ordering -- see build_gauntlet.py _fair_order; an earlier per-polygon-round() version was discarded, see caveats below)

iterations.note: out of band on the larger sample -- the n=60 probes in this steep region were too noisy to trust; moved to phase 2

phases.description: fine sweep, n=120 each, disjoint seed blocks; all four densities happen to round(43*density) to the same 10-enemy roster

pooled.note: all 4 points are independent samples of the identical 10-enemy level; pooling is valid and tightens the estimate to within +/-2.3pp

phases.description: lock density=10/43 exactly, fresh confirmation batch

caveats: v1 (discarded) density mechanism scaled each polygon's enemy count independently via round(original_count * density). With ~20 polygons holding 1-4 enemies each, most polygons' rounding thresholds coincided at density=0.25 (round(2*x): 0->1 at x=0.25 for every 2-enemy polygon), so total enemy count -- and clear rate -- jumped discontinuously there instead of responding smoothly: measured clear rates at n=60 were density=0.195->1.000, 0.2238->0.983, 0.2381->0.983, 0.2453->0.967, 0.2489->1.000, 0.2507->0.100, 0.2498->0.983 (a 0.7% density change collapsing clear rate from ~100% to 10%). Replaced with a proportional-fair global ordering (_fair_order in build_gauntlet.py) before any of the numbers in this file were collected; all phases above use the fixed mechanism.

the fixed mechanism is still coarse: only 43 distinct total-enemy-count values exist between empty and the full source roster, and near the 50% band each unit of enemy count moves clear rate several points, so 'tune to exactly 50.0%' is not achievable -- the achieved band (all four phase-2 points landing 47.5-58.3%, pooled 51.7%+/-2.3pp, confirmed 49.6% at n=250) is the practical resolution of a spawn-COUNT-only knob at this scale.
